subject.title: [Bug]: custom Xiaomi MiMo models generate invalid max_completion_tokens when maxTokens is not specified

question: For custom OpenAI-compatible models with no configured `maxTokens`, should OpenClaw omit the outbound max-token field and rely on provider defaults, derive a safe cap, or fail early with a configuration error?
rationale: The bug is real in current source, but the open fixes encode a compatibility-sensitive fallback policy that affects existing custom-provider configs.

options.title: Omit The Outbound Cap
options.body: Land a canonical linked PR that leaves `maxTokens` unset when no configured/provider/catalog source defines it, so the provider chooses its default.

options.title: Fail Early
options.body: Require a clear configuration error before the request when OpenClaw lacks enough model metadata to choose a provider-safe cap.

options.title: Derive A Conservative Cap
options.body: Ask for a narrower policy that computes a bounded output cap for omitted metadata instead of relying on provider defaults.

recommendation.title: Omit The Outbound Cap
recommendation.body: Land a canonical linked PR that leaves `maxTokens` unset when no configured/provider/catalog source defines it, so the provider chooses its default.

likelyOwner.reason: The active policy choice sits in configured fallback model resolution, where recent related history points most strongly to this resolver area.
